name: damage_lethal_death
about: Lethal damage on a live idle Troika human (lifecycle.md 'The death chain, kill to corpse'; stories/v4/brief-D-ragdoll.md § 'What retail does'). The scalar TakeDamage input past the NPC's health: CBaseCombatCharacter::OnTakeDamage 0x1032ef60 dispatches slot 144 at the threshold. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::Event_Killed 0x102bf340 -> CAI_BaseNPC::Event_Killed 0x10265ad0: DeathSound (slot 488), m_OnDeath fired (0x10265a90, activator the attacker), BecomeDead, then CBaseCombatCharacter::Event_Killed 0x1032b9b0 -> slot 301 CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0: BecomeClientRagdoll 0x10090180 with a real bone (so the pose it holds is handed to physics as it is; the ACT_DIERAGDOLL seed runs only for bone -1, 0x1009021a), the NPC made non-solid, and the think REPLACED at 0x1032c404 by SUB_PVSRemove 0x102696f0 at curtime + 10.0; m_IdealNPCState = 7, SetState(7). The dying NPC itself is the corpse: the drawn body falls and lies on the floor, the entity stays at the death spot. On this kill CreateCorpse replaces the think, so no schedule, task or state line follows the death: an ordinary kill never reaches SCHED_DIE (0x2b) or SCHED_DIE_RAGDOLL (0x2c), rig or no rig (stories/v4/packets-S1.md items 1-3: the state-7 fork 0x1028a8ec is reached only by the deferred script death, 0x1027d0a0, the Werewolf and the zombie's collapse).
notes: V4d measured solid-local-source-bone-v1 / ragdoll-v1, 15 authored convex bodies / 14 joints, real admission sim=1. Headless fixed-60-Hz regular_cop pelvis rest: scalar death 18.138 cm (stable under 5 cm/s from t=5.6), paired stealth death 17.016 cm (stable under 5 from t=6.4). Shared 20 cm asset-specific bound leaves 1.862 cm margin over the higher measured rest; no limit or hull enlarged. Both deaths consume the weighted pick but retain the current real-bone pose. Death/OnDeath/corpse occur once on the kill tick, no movement/tasks/schedules follow death. Floor/rest is measured at t=8, before the correct unseen-corpse removal at death+10 (t=13.017). The old end-floor probe inspected the retained visual even after terminal removal; V4d now actually releases it, so a t=15 floor query is invalid. Existing end Dead/alive=false probes and t=3 scalar kill/staging remain. Retail SUB_PVSRemove 0x102696f0 removes when cone/PVS/FVisible fail; corpse_removed_unseen separately asserts its windows.
